caption: The video captures a rainy urban night, wet asphalt in the foreground mirroring streaks of pink, red, yellow and blue neon. In the middle ground two dark silhouetted figures stand close together under open umbrellas. A parked car rests at the right edge, and a glowing pink tree and lit storefronts fill the background. The left figure keeps a level umbrella and shifts weight in place, drawing one leg back until the legs cross into a settled stride stance. The right figure stays upright with legs slightly apart, then steps and crosses them. An arm rises and the right umbrella tilts back and upward into a turned pose held to the close. Pavement reflections shimmer continuously, consistent with rain, while the car, tree and storefronts keep fixed positions, indicating no camera movement. Both figures remain at the same horizontal locations, their activity confined to in-place stepping, turning and umbrella reorientation rather than travel.
